name: Unknown Base MEV bot unvalidated uniswapV3SwapCallback
summary: Bot contract 0xe143b486's uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,bytes) pays the positive delta by transferFrom from a payer named in the callback data to msg.sender. The token comes from msg.sender.token0(), and nothing checks that the caller is a genuine pool. The operator EOA 0xc0ffee47 had approved the bot for WETH. The attacker's contract, posing as a pool, called the callback 219 times with the operator as payer and pulled 55.42 WETH.

loss.notes: Exact WETH depletion of operator EOA 0xc0ffee479e4cd49eafba87449225e17c53251226, which approved the bot: 219 transferFrom legs of 0.253043800616667712 WETH, then forwarded to the attacker EOA. Valued at the DefiLlama WETH quote.

ageReset.description: Direct, non-upgradeable bot runtime; its swap callback has lacked caller validation since deployment. The operator's WETH approval only set exposure.

limitations: The bot has no verified source. The missing pool check is established from the exploit trace, in which a non-pool contract's callback calls were honored, not from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 (block 37487849, index 127): EOA 0x2a49c6fd18bd111d51c4fffa6559be1d950b8eff calls its contract 0xf1a3686f4d394e52d9fdf60132e46ebdcd231b01 (selector 0x1a8a3165). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows 256 CALLs to bot 0xe143b486ab0413df0d6dad2caf6d2f61cac54730 with uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33): amount0Delta 0x0382fdfef85f0a40, a negative amount1Delta, and data (0xc0ffee479e4cd49eafba87449225e17c53251226, 0xf1a3686f...). In each successful call (219) the bot STATICCALLs msg.sender.token0() (0x0dfe1681; the attacker contract returns WETH) and then calls WETH transferFrom(0xc0ffee47..., msg.sender, 253043800616667712). The remaining 37 calls revert. The caller is a contract created by the attacker at block 33535149, not a pool from any factory, so the callback has no pool authentication. The WETH is forwarded to the attacker EOA (final Transfer, 55416592335050228928). Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at 32342289; keccak 0x8de1f538c6580086810071f794e2c9ea7b185e0be25ba7bd495dfa6f492d1039 (5591 bytes) at 32342290 and 37487848. Source-2 (block 32342290, index 16) is a top-level creation by 0xbf0e364225f12c1c0bb7b8668a816a6f13e39ccc. Earliest exercise: Etherscan tokentx for WETH of 0xc0ffee47 from block 32342290 to 37487849, paged backwards in windows of 10000 (27529 transfers), sends WETH only to pools 0x72be417afb0abea66913141c605d313bb389b59c (WETH/0x88fb150b) and 0xb2cc224c1c9fee385f8ad6a55b4d94e92359dc59 (WETH/USDC), CoW settlement 0x9008d19f58aabd9ed0d60971565aa8510560ab41, one transfer to 0xb5d99a61a5d34e3edfeea052483f49f7a922e248, and the 219 source-1 legs to 0xf1a3686f.

Reviewed loss. WETH balanceOf(0xc0ffee47) is 55514876455905996937 at block 37487848 and 98284120855768009 at 37487849; the difference 55416592335050228928 equals the 219 source-1 transferFrom legs (receipt logs 775..993) and the final transfer to 0x2a49c6fd (log 994). The allowance to the bot at block 37487848 was 2996368400181857060576.
